jobDescription: The core banking migration moves the bank's deposit and loan accounts from the legacy ledger to the new core platform in waves over three years. The Programme Manager is the accountable programme manager of record: signs the programme charter and the wave go/no-go submissions to the executive steering committee, holds the programme budget under the bank's delegated limits, directs the four project managers on the waves, and documents the programme's boundaries at each gate. The bank requires the PMP or PgMP credential, held and current, and prior experience as programme manager of record on a regulated migration. Reports to the chief operating officer; works with the steering committee, the platform vendor, the project managers and the regulatory liaison team.
requirements: Holds a current PMP or PgMP credential.
Has been the programme manager of record on a regulated migration, signing the charter and the gate submissions.
Holds the programme budget under the bank's delegated limits.
Directs the project managers on the migration waves under a documented programme method.
Documents the programme's boundaries, risks and hand-over conditions at each gate.

evidence.text: Programme manager of record for the deposit platform migration at a retail bank from 2022 to 2025, signing the programme charter and the four wave go/no-go submissions to the executive steering committee; before that, four years as a project manager on the same bank's payments programmes.
PgMP credential held since 2021 and current; PMP held since 2016; credential numbers and the institute's registry entries available for verification.
Held the migration programme budget under the bank's delegated limits, with the budget reports to the steering committee filed in the programme folder each quarter.
Directed the four project managers on the migration waves under the bank's programme method, holding the weekly wave review and the monthly programme board.
Wrote the programme boundary statement, the risk register summary and the hand-over conditions submitted at each of the five programme gates.

Work sample: the signed programme charter, one signed wave go/no-go submission with the steering committee decision record, one quarterly budget report and the credential certificates, with the programme folder references as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said she was programme manager of record for the deposit migration and holds current PgMP and PMP credentials; the credential years and the wave count she gave match the resume.
Hiring manager pre-read: the chief operating officer's office asks the packet to cite the signed charter, a signed go/no-go submission and the credential registry entries.
